routing.notes: Mechanical, fully-specified work with a deterministic gate behind it: a named assertion whose before/after text the plan spells out verbatim, a comment block moved, a doc delta whose target sentence is quoted. Nothing that has to DECIDE where a hash is computed.

Ordinary implementation and test-authoring against a spec that already exists: a property added at a named construction site, an expression-level substitution at a named member, an optional journal field threaded through three recorders. The plan-wide default tier, so anything untagged lands here rather than on the strongest model.

Work that must sequence a mid-run edit against a specific task's settle on a real git segment, decide a shape the plan left open, or reason about the production assembly rather than one file: the four timing-fixture test stages, the settle-time divergence gate, and the first test in this repo that reads src/**/*.cs as text.
